blocks.task_summary: Use Euler's method with step 0.25 to estimate y when x=2 for dy/dx = (x+2)/(x+y), given (1,0).
method_path: Iterate x_{n+1}=x_n+h, y_{n+1}=y_n+h*(x_n+2)/(x_n+y_n) from (1,0) to x=2

evidence.basis: attempt to use Euler’s method with a step of 0.25 (M1); intermediate values (A1); y=1.26 A1

blocks.task_summary: Determine if Euler estimate is over/underestimate and justify; explain why Euler method from (1,0) does not give negative y at x=2.
method_path: Justify: tangents lie above curve (concave down)
Explain: gradient at (1,0) is positive, so method follows upper branch

evidence.basis: (i) overestimate A1; because tangents lie above curve (concave down) R1; (ii) gradient at (1,0) is positive so method works in direction of upper part R1
